design_decisions: REGISTRY_PATH module-level Path to the landed registry.json, read (never written) at call time; landed registry.json stays schema-only per packet.

event_channel(event_id) production body returns None (P2B06T-DX-001: GameEvent has no broadcast field and store/feed_ingest are outside the write set), so production resolution fails closed to channel/provider/route null and accessBasis unknown until a slice stores the broadcast.

Detector reports and routing outcomes persist on a providerState#<profileId> item in the existing Profiles table (no dedicated table or store accessor exists and store/ is outside the write set); the profile's own Settings item is never touched, so an install report cannot create or clobber a profile or its confirmedAccess.

Effective installed set = latest detector report with the customer's providerPref.appOverrides winning (false removes, true adds), mirroring the TV app's effectiveInstalled; frozen cases carry no overrides and are unaffected.
Selection rank: providerPref.order position, then registry order for providers the preference does not name; registry (spike) order never overrides a named preference.

Route platform entries: verified only with verified_outcome and verified_at, carrying their own package/launch; otherwise exactly {status: REGISTRY_ROUTE_GAP} with no launch data from either platform.
accessBasis is customerConfirmed only when the chosen provider is in confirmedAccess; verified is unreachable (no entitlement integration, P2B06T-DX-005).
remaining_risks: Production event_channel has no broadcast source (P2B06T-DX-001): deployed resolve returns no route until GameEvent gains a broadcast field (B02/store amendment); deployed proof at P2-L03 can only assert the honest-unknown behavior today.

observations.observation: Any changed module-level assignment makes CMD-MUTATION-BACKEND return PYTHON_NONFUNCTION_MUTATION_GAP regardless of score. A frozen module-level seam (REGISTRY_PATH) therefore makes a mutation PASS structurally unreachable for this slice; the raw score (214/231 killed) is reported under the GAP instead. Consider exempting constant assignments whose values are read inside mutated functions, or scoring them via the functions that read them.
